# **Summary**

Here we repurpose publicly available microsatellite data to investigate global patterns of genetic diversity within and across species. Specifically, we investigated intra- and interspecific gradients of genetic diversity across Latitude and climate (Granjon et al. 2025) and across life-history strategies.

A Master student is looking at changes in genetic diversity over time in macaque species, and how these relate to their IUCN Red List Status.

# **Collaborators**

 Chloé Schmidt, Michael Gerth, Colin Garroway, Jean-Philippe Lessard, Scott Yanco, Anja Widdig, George Xydakis.

# **Publications**

**Granjon, Anne-Céline**, Michael Gerth, and Chloé Schmidt. 2025. Latitudinal Genetic Diversity Gradients Steepen toward the Poles. July 22. https://ecoevorxiv.org/repository/view/9701/.
